Synthetic 512-byte-sector GPT, independently packed with Python struct and CRC32s computed using zlib. It has a UTF-16LE name containing Chinese characters and a surrogate-pair emoji, a 256-byte partition entry, and a 1024-byte partition containing the qcom_mbn_qcdt fixture padded with zeros. The header size is 100 bytes; its CRC covers that entire declared size. No real-device provenance is claimed.
